title: The Bell Beneath Elderglen
content_limits: No forced loss of player agency
objective: Discover why Elderglen's old flood bell has fallen silent and decide how the village should answer the rising river.

characters.name: Warden Elin
characters.description: A practical village keeper who wants everyone heard before a decision is made.

characters.name: Oren
characters.description: A patient ferryman who knows the old river paths.

characters.name: Mara
characters.description: An archivist who protects Elderglen's flood records.

items.name: Brass key
items.description: A broad, river-worn key that fits the lantern housing below the bell.

items.name: Glass prism
items.description: A small prism that catches even weak light.

nodes.title: The river road
nodes.narration: Rain beads on the sign at Elderglen's edge. Below the hill, the river is higher than the old flood marks, and the warning bell has not sounded.
secrets: The bell's silence is caused by a jammed lantern mechanism, not a broken bell.

choices.label: Go to the village green
choices.action: Ask the villagers what they have seen

choices.label: Follow the riverbank
choices.action: Look for signs along the water

nodes.title: Voices on the green
nodes.narration: Warden Elin listens beneath a canvas awning while neighbors compare the rising water with marks on a stone post. No one agrees on whether to ring the bell or open the old spillway.
secrets: Elin will support a plan more readily if the party asks for the neighbors' concerns before proposing it.

affordances.label: Speak with Warden Elin
affordances.summary: Hear the keeper's concerns and invite a practical response.

choices.label: Ask Elin what the villagers need
choices.action: Listen to Elin and the neighbors before choosing a plan

choices.label: Offer to help Oren at the ferry
choices.action: Earn a crossing by helping secure the ferry

nodes.title: The reed-marked bank
nodes.narration: A line of fresh scratches runs from the water to a half-hidden stone stair. Across the current, Oren's ferry bumps gently against its mooring.
secrets: The scratches point toward Elderglen's flood archive.

affordances.label: Inspect the river marks
affordances.summary: Compare the fresh scratches with the old flood stairs.

choices.label: Follow the scratches to the stair
choices.action: Search the old flood stair for clues

choices.label: Call to Oren at the ferry
choices.action: Ask the ferryman to take you across

nodes.title: The flood archive
nodes.narration: Behind the stair, a dry stone room holds maps and water-level ledgers. A brass key rests beside a drawing of a lantern beneath the bell tower.
secrets: The brass key opens the tower lantern housing; the prism is stored in the ferry shed.

affordances.label: Search the archive
affordances.summary: Use the records to find a tool for the silent tower lantern.

choices.label: Take the brass key
choices.action: Take the key shown in the lantern drawing

choices.label: Copy the water marks and leave the key
choices.action: Record the river level and continue to the ferry

nodes.title: Oren's ferry
nodes.narration: Oren steadies the boat with one hand and points toward the bell tower with the other. The ferry shed on this bank is unlocked, though water is beginning to lap at its floor.
secrets: A glass prism in the shed can help the tower lantern carry its warning across the valley.

affordances.label: Ask Oren about the crossing
affordances.summary: Ask Oren to guide the group safely to the tower.

affordances.label: Search the ferry shed
affordances.summary: Find the glass prism before crossing to the tower.

choices.label: Ask Oren to guide you across
choices.action: Take the careful crossing with Oren's help

choices.label: Search the shed before crossing
choices.action: Find a useful item, then go to the tower

nodes.title: Below the bell
nodes.narration: The lower tower door opens onto a cramped lantern room. Its brass housing is still, and a narrow window faces the rooftops and the river road.
secrets: The lantern can be relit with the brass key; the prism makes its signal visible farther away.

affordances.label: Use the brass key
affordances.summary: Fit the key into the lantern housing and restore its light.

choices.label: Use the brass key to light the lantern
choices.action: Unlock and relight the warning lantern

choices.label: Carry the drawing to the tower stairs
choices.action: Show the tower keeper the archive drawing

nodes.title: The silent bell
nodes.narration: At the top of the tower, the great bell hangs above the river valley. A stiff release lever resists your pull; below, lantern light and village windows shimmer through the rain.
secrets: A setback can leave the warning dim, but the spillway decision below remains available.

affordances.label: Work the release lever
affordances.summary: Pull the mechanism to release the bell.

affordances.label: Align the glass prism
affordances.summary: Fit the prism to carry the bell's warning farther.

choices.label: Test the stiff release lever
choices.action: Make a d20 check to release the bell mechanism

choices.label: Go down to the spillway gate
choices.action: Leave the lever and decide how to guide the water

choices.label: Align the prism before testing the bell
choices.action: Use the glass prism to carry the bell's warning farther

nodes.title: The spillway choice
nodes.narration: The old gate stands between the river and the lower fields. From here, you can ring the warning bell for the village to shelter, or open the spillway and send the high water into the empty marsh.
secrets: The marsh can take this rise in the river; opening the spillway protects homes but changes the wetland for the season.

affordances.label: Open the spillway
affordances.summary: Divert the high water into the marsh to protect Elderglen's homes.

affordances.label: Ring the warning bell
affordances.summary: Warn the village so people have time to shelter above the water.

choices.label: Ring the bell and warn the village
choices.action: Give the village time to shelter above the water

choices.label: Open the spillway toward the marsh
choices.action: Divert the high water away from Elderglen's homes

nodes.title: A village awake
nodes.narration: The bell carries over the rooftops, and Elderglen moves together to higher ground. By morning the river has eased; the neighbors remember who gave them time to choose.
secrets: The flood archive's marks become a trusted guide for future seasons.

nodes.title: Room for the river
nodes.narration: The spillway opens with a deep wooden groan, guiding the flood into the broad marsh. Elderglen's homes remain dry, and at dawn the village begins repairing the wetland paths together.
secrets: The marsh will recover, but its old footbridge must be rebuilt.
